Subject: Post-call: procurement & security path + advocate playbook

Samir / Eden — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned:

Summary of discovery:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + retrieval-augmented answers for enterprise accounts.
- Peak latency requirement: 300ms for short responses; batch evaluation for longer analytics jobs.
- Decision criteria called out: security certs (SOC2 + data isolation), predictable pricing, and PO/contract timelines.

Immediate asks we captured:
1) Confirm economic buyer + signature path (name & title) — we heard Eden Lopez may be the economic owner. Please confirm.
2) Procurement timeline & required documents (SOW, PO format, redline window).
3) Security evidence: can we run through a targeted questionnaire? I attached our security one-pager as a start.

Proposed Redwood support / next steps:
- I will send a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone dates (pilot, procurement, go-live).
- Ben will draft a 1-page advocate email Eden can share internally, and a short ROI deck tailored to support conversations with finance.
- Marcus will prep the standard contract snippet for procurement and note typical redline turnaround.

Can you please: (a) confirm the economic buyer (name/email), (b) loop in the procurement contact who owns POs and contract review, and (c) confirm an ideal target for completing the security questionnaire?

I attached:
- redwood-security-one-pager.pdf (high level certs + data handling)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the MAP and talk tracks after Ben and Marcus weigh in.

Best,
Kimberly

Kim / Marcus — I drafted two things and attached them to this thread: (1) advocate-talk-tracks.docx (one-pager Eden can forward) and (2) a short ROI bullets list we can drop into Eden’s email. Main points below — feel free to edit before I send to Samir/Eden:

Advocate email bullets (one-paragraph):
- Problem: support costs rising with scale; manual triage is slow.
- Solution: Redwood provides predictable inference serving for RAG and summarization with policy-level data isolation and production SLAs.
- Economic upside: 30–45% estimated cost reduction on agent handling by month 3 of pilot; demo data shows 2x throughput with current cluster.
- Ask: one-month pilot (up to 50k requests) + internal access for security review.

Talk tracks for Eden when speaking to Finance:
- Pilot scoped as Proof-of-Value with limited spend and clear success metrics (ticket deflection %, avg handle time).
- Pricing model: usage + reserved capacity option for predictable spend; show run rate on month 6.
- Typical procurement timeline: 2–6 weeks once PO owner engaged.

I also added a suggested MAP with milestone dates in the MAP spreadsheet. Recommend we propose a 45-day procurement window to balance security review and contract negotiation.

If you’re good, I’ll send the advocate email to Samir and Eden and attach the ROI bullets.

Ben
